Hiring delays are one of the biggest reasons companies miss out on great candidates. A promising applicant today might already have multiple offers tomorrow, and every extra day in your process increases the risk of losing them. The challenge for many businesses is not realizing where the slowdown is happening until it is too late. This is where data analytics becomes a game-changer.
